items.name: simm-sensitivity-table
items.title: SIMM sensitivity table
items.description: Display of a SIMM sensitivity set by risk class: every delta, vega and curvature entry as supplied.
items.docs: Display-only view of a SimmSensitivitiesJson document (for example the canonical text useSimmSensitivitiesValidator returns, parsed). Sections follow the SIMM risk classes (interest rate, credit qualifying, credit non-qualifying, equity, commodity, FX); each holds the class's delta and vega tuples in input order, with columns named after the Rust tuple positions, and the curvature entries whose risk_class is that class. Empty fields are omitted. Nothing is summed, netted, regrouped or converted; amounts are in the set's base currency, which is shown. Accepts sensitivities, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: simm-report
items.title: SIMM report
items.description: Display of a native SIMM initial-margin result: headline amount, an indicative badge, the component breakdown and a simm_detail drill-down.
items.docs: Display-only view of the ImResult returned by useSimmIm (margin.SimmCalculator#calculateFromSensitivities). The headline is the returned amount with methodology, as_of, mpor_days and the detail's mpor_scale. An Indicative badge is always shown, beside the returned approximation flag: the result is for indicative funding and capacity analysis, not for reconciling a counterparty margin call. The breakdown lists the returned component amounts as exact money in returned key order; the drill-down shows the returned risk_class_margins and, for a selected component, its buckets (k, signed_sum) and weighted sensitivities (risk weight, concentration factor). Nothing is aggregated. Accepts result, loading, error, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: simm-calculator
items.title: SIMM calculator
items.description: Edits a SIMM sensitivity set and calculation date, shows the validated set by risk class and presents the returned initial margin.
items.docs: Composes schema-form over the generated simm_sensitivities_json contract (started from defaultJson, else the Rust schema example), a date-input for the calculation date, simm-sensitivity-table over the natively validated canonical set and simm-report over the returned ImResult. Validation and calculation are caller callbacks: connect validate to useSimmSensitivitiesValidator and onSubmit plus result, loading and error to useSimmIm. Rust accepts only USD-based sets; another base currency surfaces the native error in the report. Accepts defaultJson, asOf, onAsOfChange, validate, onSubmit, result, loading, error, formatValue and density props.

items.name: use-simm-im
items.title: useSimmIm
items.description: Calculates indicative SIMM initial margin of a sensitivity set through the WASM worker.
items.docs: margin.SimmSensitivities.fromJson over sensitivitiesJson, new margin.SimmCalculator(version, mporDays) with omitted options left unset so Rust applies its defaults (version v2_6, registry MPOR), then calculateFromSensitivities in the set's own base currency on asOf. Both handles are freed. Rust accepts only USD; another base currency, an unknown tenor or an invalid date returns the native error unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-simm-sensitivities-validator
items.title: useSimmSensitivitiesValidator
items.description: Validates SIMM sensitivity JSON natively and returns its canonical text through the WASM worker.
items.docs: margin.SimmSensitivities.fromJson, validate and toJson: canonical SimmSensitivitiesJson text, or the native error for unknown fields, currencies, tenors or credit sectors. The handle is freed. Pass it as schema-form's or simm-calculator's validate. Requires the shared Finstack provider.

items.name: csa-editor
items.title: CSA editor
items.description: Edits a Credit Support Annex with the generated form, optionally starting from a Rust regulatory preset.
items.docs: Composes schema-form over the generated csa_spec contract (started from defaultJson, else the Rust schema example). When loadPreset is supplied, a preset bar loads the Rust USD or EUR regulatory CSA (margin.csaSpecUsdRegulatory, csaSpecEurRegulatory) or regulatory terms for a typed currency, CSA id and collateral curve (margin.csaSpecRegulatory); the inputs start empty and a rejected preset shows the native error. Validation, presets and every term are native: connect validate to useCsaValidator, loadPreset to useCsaPreset and onSubmit to the useVm, useMarginCalls or useMarginCallDates request. Accepts defaultJson, validate, onSubmit, loadPreset and density props.

items.name: margin-call-table
items.title: Margin call table
items.description: Display of native variation margin: one date's result with Rust's call decision and net margin, a margin-call schedule and the contractual call dates.
items.docs: Display-only view of what useVm, useMarginCalls and useMarginCallDates return. The variation margin section shows the Rust call decision (margin.vmResultRequiresCall) as a badge, the Rust net margin (margin.vmResultNetMargin: post minus collect, positive when the desk posts) in the result's currency, the date and settlement date, and the VmResult money terms (gross exposure, threshold, independent amount, net exposure, collateral balance, unrounded call, MTA, rounding increment, post and collect amounts) as exact money. The margin calls section lists VmCalculator#generateMarginCalls in returned order; the call dates section lists VmCalculator#marginCallDates. Nothing is netted, thresholded or rounded. Accepts vm, calls, callDates, loading, error, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: use-csa-validator
items.title: useCsaValidator
items.description: Validates CSA specification JSON natively and returns its canonical text through the WASM worker.
items.docs: margin.csaSpecValidate (currencies, monetary bounds, calendar lookup, unknown fields), then new margin.VmCalculator(json)#csa serialized: canonical CsaSpec text, or the native error. The handle is freed. Pass it as schema-form's or csa-editor's validate. Requires the shared Finstack provider.

items.name: use-csa-preset
items.title: useCsaPreset
items.description: Loads a Rust regulatory CSA preset through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Returns a loader: {kind: "usd"} calls margin.csaSpecUsdRegulatory, {kind: "eur"} csaSpecEurRegulatory, and {kind: "regulatory", currency, id, collateralCurve} csaSpecRegulatory; it resolves to the returned CsaSpec or rejects with the native error (unknown currency, a currency without regulatory terms, an empty id). Pass it as csa-editor's loadPreset. Requires the shared Finstack provider.

items.name: use-vm
items.title: useVm
items.description: Calculates variation margin of one exposure under a CSA through the WASM worker.
items.docs: new margin.VmCalculator(csaJson), then calculate(exposure, postedCollateral, the CSA's own base currency, asOf), with margin.vmResultRequiresCall and vmResultNetMargin on the result: {result, requiresCall, netMargin}. The handle is freed. An invalid CSA, a non-finite amount (a cleared field is NaN) or an unregistered calendar returns the native error unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-margin-calls
items.title: useMarginCalls
items.description: Runs an exposure series into a native margin-call schedule through the WASM worker.
items.docs: new margin.VmCalculator(csaJson)#generateMarginCalls(exposures, initialCollateral): one MarginCall per date that calls, in the order given; [ISO date, exposure] pairs are in the CSA base currency. The handle is freed. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-margin-call-dates
items.title: useMarginCallDates
items.description: Lists the contractual margin-call dates of a CSA through the WASM worker.
items.docs: new margin.VmCalculator(csaJson)#marginCallDates(start, end): ISO call dates on the CSA calendar at its VM frequency, inclusive. The handle is freed. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.
